options.opa: The Necessary Number to Treat (NNT) is the inverse of the Relative Risk (RR).
options.opb: The Relative Risk Reduction (RRR) can clearly differentiate the big risks and benefits of the small ones.
options.opc: The Relative Risk Reduction (RRR) is a measure of the therapeutic effort that clinicians and patients must make to avoid negative results of their illnesses.
options.opd: The Number Necessary to Damage (NND) is calculated by dividing the unit by the Number Needed to Treat (NNT).
options.ope: The Absolute Risk Reduction (RRA) is calculated by the absolute difference of the episode rate in the control group minus the episode rate in the intervention group.
